# Daniel Obiefule - Software Engineer Portfolio

> Portfolio site for Daniel Obiefule, a Software Engineer based in Mauritius currently focused on web development, specializing in WordPress, Elementor, and GoHighLevel funnels and CRM automation.

## About

Daniel Obiefule is a Software Engineer currently focused on web development who has delivered 15+ client websites, including Fillin (formerly Engen Mauritius) and the Artemis Hospitals Mauritius network. He builds SEO-friendly WordPress and Elementor websites, GoHighLevel funnels, and CRM automation workflows, and previously worked as an IT Support and Network Security Engineer Intern.

## Sections

- About: background, specialization, and soft skills
- Experience: technology stack across CMS & tools (WordPress, Elementor, Thrive Architect, WooCommerce, GoHighLevel, Zapier, Git), frontend (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, Bootstrap), backend (Node.js, PHP, Java, Python, MySQL, MongoDB, REST APIs), and IT support/networking
- Services: front-end development & web design, WordPress & funnels, site maintenance & optimization
- Portfolio: live client projects (WordPress/Elementor sites and GoHighLevel funnels) and personal projects (Figma designs, JavaScript apps)
- Contact: email and WhatsApp
